info.name: 📌 OpenAI API
info.description:
### About

"OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company. Our mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity."

OpenAI builds the GPT models and serves them through its own Responses and Chat APIs, plus images, audio, video and embeddings. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Model makers**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- OpenAI Account: [https://platform.openai.com/](https://platform.openai.com/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `openai_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:openai_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference)
    
- Models: [https://platform.openai.com/docs/models](https://platform.openai.com/docs/models)

item.name: Responses

body.raw:
{
    "model": "gpt-4o",
    "instructions": "You are a helpful assistant.",
    "input": "In two sentences, what is the difference between a large language model and a reasoning model?",
    "stream": true,
    "store": false,
    "max_output_tokens": 4096
}

item.description: "The Responses API is a new API primitive that combines the best of both the Chat Completions and Assistants APIs. It’s simpler to use, and includes built-in tools provided by OpenAI that execute tool calls and add results automatically to the conversation context. As model capabilities continue to evolve, we believe the Responses API will provide a more flexible foundation for developers building agentic applications."
